title: Vehicle Detection in Non-Parking Zones
tagline: Catches unauthorized parking the moment it happens.

meta.title: Vehicle Detection in Non-Parking Zones | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: Catches unauthorized parking the moment it happens.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Unauthorized parking causes congestion and safety risk, but manual enforcement is slow and inconsistent, so violations routinely slip through.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: Geofencing combined with motion tracking tells stationary violations apart from vehicles just passing through, and fires an alert automatically.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Faster enforcement and noticeably better traffic flow in monitored zones.
